evidence: The official candleSnapshot repeatedly omitted the newest one or two completed one-minute rows near the minute boundary.
A later official read contained every expected row from the position opening through the assessed cutoff.
The controller refused to synthesize missing rows, emitted degraded telemetry, attempted no profit-lock order, and retried on the next cycle.
No interior or permanently missing row was observed in the later source read.

alternative_causes_considered.permanent_data_loss: not supported because later official reads were complete
alternative_causes_considered.backend_crash: rejected because heartbeats and funding reconciliation continued
alternative_causes_considered.unprotected_position: rejected because the venue reduce-only stop remained armed
alternative_causes_considered.profit_lock_logic_bug: not established; the controller enforced its exact completed-bar contract

economic_impact_assessment.residual_risk: A future finalization gap after activation could delay a completed-bar profit-lock decision until the next poll.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The observed one- to two-bar gaps are bounded official-source publication lag rather than permanent candle loss.
falsifiers: an interior candle remains missing after a later official read
a gap persists for more than two cohort cycles
a completed-bar lock trigger is proven missed after activation
the venue stop becomes absent while profit-lock data is unavailable

recommendation.Recommendation: Keep the existing fail-closed controller and venue stop; monitor finalization lag and trigger impact before proposing a live behavioral change.
recommendation.Why now: The degraded event is recurrent, but this lifecycle never approached the activation threshold and the source recovered automatically.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: Newest completed candle publication occasionally lags the cohort poll, temporarily withholding profit-lock evaluation.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Any open SPCX lifecycle with completed-bar trailing profit protection.
Alternatives considered: silently ignore the incomplete newest candle
block and retry inside the same poll
retain fail-closed next-cycle retry and explicit degradation
recommendation.Expected upside: Preserves source honesty and avoids adding entry latency or fabricated bars.
Main risks and failure modes: a future activated lock can be delayed one cycle
repeated degraded telemetry can obscure a genuinely persistent outage
a later source behavior change can invalidate the bounded-lag diagnosis
Validation completed: later official history reconciled every expected candle
current activation threshold and favorable excursion compared
venue stop and backend recovery verified
Validation still required: measure publication lag distribution over activated and inactive lifecycles
alert separately on persistent or interior gaps
review the first event occurring after profit-lock activation
Success metrics: every gap resolves within two cycles
Failure / rollback triggers: activated trigger delayed beyond one poll
venue stop loss or backend fault
source publication lag materially exceeds the current envelope
recommendation.Confidence level: Medium-high for current-lifecycle no-impact; medium for the general bounded-finalization diagnosis.

sources: Hyperliquid public candleSnapshot for xyz:SPCX at 1m
